subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: When invoked, the skill shall verify the requirement basis before anything else: admit a merged per-feature PRD (reading its `effective.md`) or citable corpus requirement anchors; refuse a draft or unmerged PRD and a basis-free request, naming the state and the remedy, writing nothing.
rationale: grilling against an unfrozen or absent contract yields a record citing unstable anchors (#D-3)
fit_criterion: fixture sessions: merged-PRD and corpus bases admitted; draft-PRD and no-basis fixtures refused with state + remedy named, zero writes
